name: GlideSysListControl
title: GlideSysListControl - Scoped
summary: The GlideSysListControl API provides methods that enable you to determine if the New or Edit buttons are displayed.

members.name: getControlID
members.summary: Returns the sys_id for the control.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String sys_id of the control 
var sysListCtrl = new GlideSysListControl("incident");
var controlID = sysListCtrl.getControlID();
gs.info(controlID);

Output:

91a807a60a0a3c74012113e28b47ca2e

members.name: isOmitEditButton
members.summary: Returns true if the edit button is not displayed.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True when the edit button is not displayed. 
var sysListCtrl = new GlideSysListControl("incident");
var isOmitted = sysListCtrl.isOmitEditButton();
gs.info(isOmitted);

Output:

false

members.name: isOmitNewButton
members.summary: Returns true when the New button is not displayed.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True when the new button is not displayed. 
var sysListCtrl = new GlideSysListControl("incident");
var isOmitted = sysListCtrl.isOmitNewButton();
gs.info(isOmitted);

Output:
